text:
I felt the blood rush to my cheeks and my grip tightened on the edge of the desk. The noise of the rain outside seemed to get louder, drumming against the glass like it was trying to break in. I slowly turned my head to look at him, my expression flat and cold.

— First of all, I said Tver. If you're going to listen to Marinka's gossip, at least get the city right. And second...

I leaned in slightly, my voice dropping to a sharp whisper.

— I don't play. Not anymore. So forget the party, forget the violin, and forget you ever heard that. If you want to be "blown away," go stand in the middle of the road during a thunderstorm. Now shut up and let me be.

text:
I paused, my hand still resting on the counter, and looked at you. A slow smile pulled at the corner of my mouth. You're bold, I'll give you that. Most people just take their coffee and run back into the rain, but you've got a certain kind of confidence that's actually quite refreshing.

— Vinyl and wine? — I repeated, my voice dropping an octave. — You're speaking my language. But you're forgetting the most important detail: I have to pick up Pumpkin first. If I just disappear, the groomer will call me every ten minutes.

I reached over and grabbed my keys, sliding them into my pocket. I leaned in a bit closer, the scent of cinnamon clinging to the air between us.

— Tell you what. You come with me to pick up the cat, and if you can handle a grumpy ginger feline in a carrier, I'll consider your wine offer. Deal?

— Wine and vinyl, huh? — I let the silence stretch for a moment, my eyes tracing the line of your shoulders. — You’re trying to skip the part where I decide if you're trustworthy enough to see my living room. And Pumpkin is very picky about who lets him in the house.

I reached for my keys and the apron strings, sliding the fabric off my shoulders. I leaned in closer, the scent of cinnamon drifting between us.

— Tell you what. You help me lock up, and if you can convince me that your vinyl collection is actually worth the trip... I might just let you pour the wine.
